name: files
title: Files
description: Presigned file uploads with local-disk and Cloudflare R2 storage drivers.

env.name: AURIC_FILE_STORAGE_PATH
env.description: Disk path for the local driver

env.name: AURIC_R2_ACCOUNT_ID
env.description: Required when the driver is r2

env.name: AURIC_R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID
env.description: Required when the driver is r2

env.name: AURIC_R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
env.description: Required when the driver is r2

env.name: AURIC_R2_BUCKET
env.description: Required when the driver is r2

env.name: AURIC_R2_PUBLIC_BASE_URL
env.description: Optional public base URL for public files

env.name: AURIC_FILE_MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES
env.description: Hard cap on one upload (25 MiB)
